trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 1 negation-contrast construction(s): ", not the diagram." — state the positive claim directly

Four negation shapes, all substantive: 'Mass is a property of the knot type, not the diagram' (the R-I/R-II/R-III separation IS the block's content); 'regular isotopy invariant ..., not a knot invariant'; 'does not depend on the diagram'; 'does not cancel'. Substantive-mathematical-contrast false-positive class.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: 'This is why an excited hydrogen atom is still hydrogen: ... But it is in a different state: ...' is an explanatory application of the preceding invariance table, both clauses load-bearing; not a setup-then-reframe where the second clause carries everything.

trap-em-dash.evidence: Two dashes, both restrictive appositives naming the invariant class just quantified ('R-I + R-II + R-III invariants - the topological knot type'). Low density; no comma-vs-full-stop dodging.

trap-triples.evidence: 'three local moves' is Reidemeister's theorem (a true trichotomy) and the R-I/R-II/R-III triples throughout are forced by it; the particle list is a four.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Block ends on the Archimedean-specialisation boilerplate; the last authored line is 'the trefoil's writhe is different ..., and the binding energy differs', a factual consequence.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: 'The difference between identity and state is precisely one Reidemeister move: R-I' looks like a closer but is the antecedent of the next paragraph's 'This is why ...', so it is load-bearing rather than terminal restatement.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'precisely one Reidemeister move' is an exact count, verified against the table; no unqualified maxima.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: The table footnote does not parse aloud or on the page: 'R-III preserves writhe but is not the only invariance of writhe; writhe is a regular isotopy invariant (R-II + R-III), not a knot invariant (R-I + R-II + R-III).' The 'but is not the only invariance of writhe' clause has no readable referent.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: PROPOSED (structural, math-adjacent - not fixed inline): replace the footnote with 'Writhe is a regular isotopy invariant (invariant under R-II and R-III) but not a knot invariant, since R-I changes it by $\pm1$.' Correct row is x / ok / ok; cell should read $\checkmark^*$.
